decisions.reason: Only mentioned on the website with no own page or awards, indicating low visible commitment and likely disappointing results, so escalation of commitment is weaker and dropping is more likely.
Presented on its own page, signaling visible commitment and investment, so management tends to persist and justify the earlier launch.
Like B, it is only mentioned without distinct positioning or awards, so little public commitment and unremarkable results make dropping more likely to free resources.
Strong public commitment through its own page and design awards, high sunk investment, and centrality to the firm's design reputation make dropping very unlikely.
